findings.title: Qualify historical version and ownership in the saved frontend synthesis

locations.quoted_issue: (v3, candidate/draft).
locations.proposed_correction: Preserve body and prepend a dated qualification: the saved answer uses frontend composition v3, while v4 is current; microfrontend-team and Portal-Team organizational equivalence is unconfirmed.

locations.quoted_issue: **Microfrontend team ([[entities/portal-team]])**
locations.proposed_correction: Qualify the identity equivalence and root/interface ownership: the sources name a microfrontend-team role for shared availability and repository review, without establishing its organization or every interface approver.

locations.quoted_issue: the root tier deliberately knows nothing about containers or tiles
locations.proposed_correction: Qualify that only single-child registration is established; root import-map contents are not limited by that declaration.

locations.quoted_issue: **no tier owns cross-tile event delivery**
locations.proposed_correction: Qualify as no tier owner assigned by the supplied model, without proving absence of an actual owner.

source_support.quote: version: 4
The sources record role declarations. Current named owners and effective approvals remain unknown.
Root layout declares only `@fm/base`.
This is proposed behavior; the source does not establish an accepted connection limit or deployed service.

findings.title: Limit root registration claim to inspected registration

locations.quoted_issue: the base tier deliberately knows nothing about containers or tiles
locations.proposed_correction: Replace with: the root registers only MFE Base; containers and tiles load through subsequent stages. Single-child registration does not establish absent import-map entries.

source_support.quote: Initialize Single-SPA and register only MFE Base.
| Root configuration and import map | Locate modules and support shared loading configuration. |

findings.title: Different labels do not prove distinct organizations

locations.quoted_issue: to the microfrontend team, not to the Portal Team.
locations.proposed_correction: Remove the unsupported organizational distinction and merge prohibition; state the named source roles and leave their organizational relationship unconfirmed.

source_support.quote: The principles assign shared backend availability to the microfrontend team.
Current named owners and effective approvals remain unknown.

findings.title: Missing approval evidence does not prove unapproved status

locations.quoted_issue: The release proposal is likewise unapproved
locations.proposed_correction: Use present approval remains unconfirmed. The proposals cannot establish effective current responsibilities from the retained evidence.

locations.quoted_issue: The release proposal and the admin release checklist are unapproved and under construction
locations.proposed_correction: State unconfirmed approval/authority separately from the checklist-only under-construction state.

source_support.quote: Their current authority remains unconfirmed.
These are documented responsibility statements, without confirmed present approval.
Checklist remains under construction; FMAA decommissioning is planned.

findings.title: Qualify saved release answer approval assertions

locations.quoted_issue: **draft, unapproved release proposal**
locations.proposed_correction: Preserve saved body; prepend dated qualification that proposal authority/approval are unconfirmed rather than a proven unapproved decision.

locations.quoted_issue: unapproved/under construction
locations.proposed_correction: The notice must state that only the checklist is explicitly under construction.

source_support.quote: Original page revisions, current authority, and human approval remain unconfirmed.
Checklist remains under construction; FMAA decommissioning is planned.

findings.title: Logical separation does not prove transport invariance

locations.quoted_issue: unaffected by which ingress endpoint forwards the initial assets
locations.proposed_correction: State separate logical stages; effects of effective routing and rewrite configuration remain unverified.

locations.quoted_issue: the ingress chain does not change the API contract
locations.proposed_correction: Retain logical separation, without guaranteeing effective route/rewrite/header behavior.

source_support.quote: The logical MFE-to-BFF contract remains distinct from this reported transport path.
DNS, effective upstreams, gateway routes, and active deployment remain unverified.

findings.title: Keep SDK validation conditional and avoid an invented hop

locations.quoted_issue: Requests to portal-backed applications are validated by a request filter supplied by the [[entities/single-ui-sdk]].
locations.proposed_correction: Qualify supported requests in applications that adopt and enable the conditional SDK filter; universal adoption/configuration are unconfirmed.

locations.quoted_issue: the shared SDK in front of the BFF
locations.proposed_correction: Ask which downstream applications adopt/enable the SDK and which paths they protect; no universal SDK-to-BFF hop is established.

source_support.quote: SDK adoption across application backends remains reported architecture because those exact consumers are unavailable.
conditionally registers validation.
Configuration therefore determines which requests receive SDK authentication checks.

findings.title: Entitlement prerequisites do not establish BFF enforcement

locations.quoted_issue: so the BFF's admin APIs are gated by that authorization data.
locations.proposed_correction: State manual entitlement prerequisites, with exact backend mapping and enforcement unverified.

source_support.quote: These procedures describe prerequisites; they do not establish completed grants for any current operator.
These declarations do not establish operator permissions, approved workflow, or passing maker-checker enforcement.

findings.title: Keep bundler-governance inference separate from mandatory policy

locations.quoted_issue: it is a platform-level compatibility decision, not a local application choice.
locations.proposed_correction: Label inference: changes affecting shared loading/dependencies may require coordination; exact provider/consumer evidence is needed. Research alone establishes no universal mandatory policy for local bundler choices.

source_support.quote: Inference: Changed output formats or shared dependencies can affect the portal loading boundary.
The applicable implementation versions require inspection before validating that inference for a proposed migration.

findings.title: Do not expand the documented CSV upload record scope

locations.quoted_issue: Configuration promotion moves tenant metadata, routing, authentication, entitlements, and validation settings into the Portal Admin service.
locations.proposed_correction: Limit upload to Module Map, Drawer Category, and Tile Configuration records; distinguish the routing, authentication, entitlement, and validation prerequisites it connects.

source_support.quote: The documented flow starts with Module Map, Drawer Category, and Tile Configuration changes in Development.
Configuration promotion connects tenant metadata, routing, authentication, entitlements, and validation.

findings.title: Qualify EMS2-only wording beside the current tile model

locations.quoted_issue: Tile eligibility is configured from [[entities/ems2]] roles
locations.proposed_correction: Label historical capability wording and add current candidate per-tile EMS2/CES admission, separate from grant-union hasPermission; include CES canonical context.

source_support.quote: Each tile must select its entitlement provider independently.
Keep that shared functional check separate from tile admission.

findings.title: Separate shell registration from container loading

locations.quoted_issue: uses [[entities/single-spa]] and SystemJS to load the container module
locations.proposed_correction: State Single-SPA registers the shell; the shell selects the container and SystemJS loads named modules while forwarding props.

source_support.quote: Single-SPA registers the shell; SystemJS loads named modules.
The shell selects `props.container` and forwards `module`, `tile`, `parameters`, `panelId`, and `tabId`.

findings.title: Do not infer a catalog-upload prerequisite for every release

locations.quoted_issue: Release execution depends on the Admin Module promotion flow.
locations.proposed_correction: Limit this workflow to releases that promote catalog configuration; the supplied material does not establish every Portal/tenant release requires a CSV upload.

source_support.quote: The documented flow starts with Module Map, Drawer Category, and Tile Configuration changes in Development.
The proposal covers Portal routing, route enabling, tenant interfaces, and Portal-owned production changes.

limits: Semantic comparison against canonical candidate/draft records only; no source authority, human review, publication, accepted current policy, deployment or business behavior is established.

Full-byte SHA-256 values were computed after reading. All five input hashes match the assignment. Output hashes identify the before-correction bytes.
No canonical record, wiki page, alias, provenance binding or receipt was edited before this initial checkpoint.
Preserve existing saved exploration bodies and prepend dated qualifications unless regeneration is separately requested.
No additional canonical topic or wiki concept page was required by the inspected scope.

Fourteen assigned wiki outputs were subsequently corrected under parent authorization. Saved exploration bodies are byte-preserved beneath added dated notices. Canonical records, aliases and provenance bindings remain untouched by this reviewer.
